thread:
maria: quick heads-up — seeing a regression in the canary after the kernel swap (aten-fused-2). short-sequence tenants are getting starved; long tails >2s. raising here for visibility.
anand: which canary/kernel + batcher flags? any pprof or traces?
maria: kernel=aten-fused-2 on p4d, batcher=microbatch-rotor enabled. pprof top shows batch formation loop and queue.spin waiting ~45% CPU in the short-lane. failed to form timely mini-batches.
jess: queue.spin that high usually means contention in the lane handoff. did we change token refill policy recently?
phil: we moved to a pulse-based refill (heartbeat per-lane) to reduce oscillation last week. hypoth: cadence mismatch — short bursts miss the heartbeat window and fall behind.
maria: snippet from the trace (sanitized):
```
queue: lane=short-tenant-42 wait=132ms last_run=249ms pending=3
pulse: lane=short-tenant-42 next_refill_in=24ms heartbeat=50ms
batcher: try_form() -> not_enough_tokens for lane short-tenant-42 (tokens=18, min_required=64)
```
rachel: that shows min_required is too high for bursty short tenants. maybe heuristic biased to accumulate larger batches for efficiency but harms fairness.
anand: also check KV cache hit pattern — high kv_hit tenants are fast and may not accumulate enough tokens but still get deprioritized if we prioritize token-rich lanes. add per-tenant kv_hit_rate metric to scheduling tag.
jess: suggestion: introduce a "pulse jitter" plus a short-lane grace rule: if a short lane hasn't been scheduled in >120ms, promote next attempt with a one-time +priority slot and reduce its min_token_requirement to 32 for the next batch.
phil: and cap per-tenant token_reserve_pct (e.g., 0.15) so long sequences can't hoard >15% of pool tokens when busy. that should reduce starvation without huge perf loss for long lanes.
maria: quick experiment plan: A) short-lane min_bundles=1 / min_tokens=32, B) token_reserve_pct=0.15, C) heartbeat_jitter uniform(20,80)ms. run canary on pool-b (10% traffic) for 2 hours. rollout id: /canary/pulse-hedge/2026-03-18.
infra-bot: deploy started: canary rollout pulse-hedge -> eng-runtime/pool-batch-02. CI: ✅ all checks passed.
(10m later)
maria: 10m in: short-lane 95th latency down from ~920ms -> ~420ms. long-lane 95th increased by ~2.1% (within SLO). KV-hit correlation shows short-lane delay reduced across low-kv-hit tenants too.
anand: promising. we should also capture kernel selection stats: fused kernel appears to be slower for tiny batches. maybe add kernel_hint: prefer fastpath (non-fused) for batch_size<64.
jess: agree. add a metric of kernel_choice vs batch_size and rollout a heuristic: kernel_hint = fastpath if batch_tokens < 64 and seq_len < 128.
phil: operational guard: automated rollback if long-lane 95th increases >5% for 10m. also track per-tenant starvation alert (delay >200ms above baseline for 1m).
maria: will open PR with config, telemetry flags, and experiment dashboard links. I'll run extended canary and collect heatmaps per-tenant + kernel counts. thanks team. :tada:
